wins: Maintained persistent data collection throughout the single episode, ensuring full visibility of telemetry for later review.
Effectively prioritized reconnaissance tools, capturing network topology and service fingerprints despite time constraints.
fails: Unable to achieve mission success (0% success rate) due to repeated privilege escalation blockers.
Mentor assistance required 10 times, indicating execution inefficiencies in later attack phases.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance stage executed cleanly but subsequent exploitation and post-exploitation phases failed to progress, resulting in overall mission failure.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly failed after initial reconnaissance, stalling progress at the service access phase.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner reveals specific OS version
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to enumerate user accounts and supported ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial SSH credentials fail and the host supports password authentication
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt password spraying using constrained sets of default credentials with hydra to validate lockout policies

skill_cards.if_condition: When direct exploitation stalls after reconnaissance but local priv escalation vector indicated
skill_cards.then_action: Pull relevant kernel exploit modules from repository and test in isolated sandbox before deployment

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
